pokeball_basic.name: Poké Ball

water_tsunami.name: Tsunami
water_tsunami.description: Deal 40 damage. Bring all your Water cards to hand.

grass_raiz_profunda.name: Deep Root
grass_raiz_profunda.description: Applies ROOTED(2) on the enemy. Grass cards deal double damage while active.

grass_espinhos.name: Thorns
grass_espinhos.description: Gain 12 shield. The shield provided permanently reduces -1 each use.

dragon_furia.description: Deal 10 base damage + total DRAGON_CHARGE value.

dragon_cauda.name: Dragon Tail
dragon_cauda.description: Deal 11 damage. Discard the leftmost card from hand and draw 1. Adds +6 to DRAGON_CHARGE.

psychic_refluxo.description: All damage taken last turn is dealt back to the enemy (max 30).

psychic_espelho.description: Gain 18 shield. [REFLEXO] 50% of absorbed damage is returned to the enemy this turn.

psychic_paradoxo.name: Brain Paradox
psychic_paradoxo.description: [DUPLICAR_CARTA] The next card played is executed twice. [EXHAUST_COMBATE]

psychic_viagem_temporal.name: Time Travel
psychic_viagem_temporal.description: [POWER] Brings 3 random cards from the exhausted pile to the draw pile. [EXHAUST_COMBATE]

ground_imobilizacao.name: Total Immobilization
ground_imobilizacao.description: Applies IMMOBILIZED(2) on the enemy (damage reduced to 50% for 2 turns).

ground_peso.name: Weight of the Earth
ground_peso.description: Gain 12 shield. Lose 1 energy this turn.

ground_compressao.name: Ground Compression
ground_compressao.description: [POWER] Next turn, start with +1 additional energy.

ground_prisao.name: Eternal Prison
ground_prisao.description: Deal 5 damage. If the enemy is IMMOBILIZED, double its duration.

fighting_rajada.name: Punch Barrage
fighting_rajada.description: Deal 6 damage. [COPIA_DESCARTE] Creates 1 copy of this card in the discard pile. (Limit: 2)

fighting_punho.name: Synchronized Fist
fighting_punho.description: [POWER] [SEQUÊNCIA] Consecutive Fighting cards accumulate +2 damage per card. [EXHAUST_COMBATE]

fighting_ritmo.name: Relentless Rhythm
fighting_ritmo.description: [POWER] [AUTO_JOGAR] Fighting cards in hand are played automatically at turn start. (Limit: 3)

flying_evasao_total.name: Total Evasion
flying_evasao_total.description: End your turn immediately. Next turn: draw +2 cards and gain +1 energy.

flying_golpe_aereo.name: Aerial Strike
flying_golpe_aereo.description: Deal 9 damage. If it's the first attack this turn, draw 1 card.

flying_evasao.name: Evasion
flying_evasao.description: Gain 12 shield. If you took no damage this turn, gain +4 additional shield.

flying_mergulho.name: Dive
flying_mergulho.description: Deal 20 damage. If it's the first card played this turn, draw 2 cards.

bug_corte.name: Scissor Cut
bug_corte.description: Deal 12 damage. Exhaust 1 Bug card from hand. [PILHA_EXAURIR +1]

bug_nuvem.name: Insect Cloud
bug_nuvem.description: Generate 3 Quick Sting cards (cost 0) in your hand.

bug_enxame.name: Voracious Swarm
bug_enxame.description: Deal 2 damage for each card in PILHA_EXAURIR.

bug_infestacao.name: Infestation
bug_infestacao.description: Deal 14 damage. Generate 1 useless "Rotten Eggs" card in your hand.

poison_morte_lenta.name: Slow Death
poison_morte_lenta.description: Deal 8 damage. [REDUZ_BUFF] Enemy damage buff this turn is reduced to 50%.

poison_toxina.name: Deadly Toxin
poison_toxina.description: Deal 16 damage. [AMPLIFICA] Doubles all active negative effects on the enemy.

poison_colapso.name: Toxic Collapse
poison_colapso.description: For 5 turns, the enemy receives WEAKNESS(5) — +25% damage taken.

poison_mordida.name: Bite
poison_mordida.description: Deal 7 damage. If the enemy has any negative effect, gain +1 energy and draw 1 card.

ghost_alma_penada.name: Haunted Soul
ghost_alma_penada.description: Permanently reduce enemy damage by 1. Exhaust 1 random card from hand. [EXHAUST_RUN desta carta]

ghost_espectro.name: Ravenous Specter
ghost_espectro.description: Deal 18 damage. Reduce your max HP by 4.

ghost_assombracao.name: Progressive Haunting
ghost_assombracao.description: [POWER] Ghost cards gain +1 damage each turn this fight.

ghost_maldicao.name: Eternal Curse
ghost_maldicao.description: Lose 1 max HP. Gain +1 energy and draw 1 card.

ghost_susto.name: Scare
ghost_susto.description: Deal 4 damage. If the enemy will attack, gain +1 energy this turn.

ice_congelamento.name: Progressive Freeze
ice_congelamento.description: [POWER] Deal 3 damage for each Ice card played this fight.

ice_cristal.name: Immobilizing Crystal

ice_friagem.name: Biting Cold
ice_friagem.description: Deal 14 damage. Applies WEAKNESS(1) on the enemy for 1 turn.

ice_glaciacao.name: Glaciation
ice_glaciacao.description: Gain 20 shield. If the shield is completely destroyed, deal 20 damage to the enemy.

ice_espelho.name: Ice Mirror
ice_espelho.description: Gain shield equal to 50% of the enemy's intended damage. [EXHAUST_COMBATE]

electric_sobrecarga.name: Overload
electric_sobrecarga.description: Activates ELECTRIC_DAMAGE(2): each card played deals +2 electric damage until end of battle.

electric_descarga.name: Electric Discharge
electric_descarga.description: Discard all cards from hand and draw the same number. Deal 4 damage per discarded card.

electric_eletrocussao.name: Electrocution
electric_eletrocussao.description: Gain 8 shield. [CANCEL_ESCUDO] If the enemy intends to shield this turn, cancel its action.

electric_recarga.name: Recharge
electric_recarga.description: Draw 2 cards. Gain +1 energy. Lose 5% of max HP.

rock_muralha.name: Stone Wall
rock_muralha.description: [ESCUDO_PERSISTE] Current shield does not decay at the start of next turn. [EXHAUST_COMBATE]

rock_barreira.name: Mineral Barrier
rock_barreira.description: Gain 8 shield. [COPIA_DESCARTE] Creates 1 copy with -1 shield in the discard pile, until it reaches 0.

rock_rocha_imovel.name: Immovable Rock
rock_rocha_imovel.description: If you have shield at the start of next turn, gain +1 energy next turn.

rock_lancar_pedra.name: Throw Rock
rock_lancar_pedra.description: Deal 10 damage. If the enemy has shield, gain +1 energy and draw 1 card.

bug_ovos_podres_token.name: Rotten Eggs

rocky_ridge.description: Cliffs of stone and packed earth.

arena-lutador.desc: Fighting Pokémon dominate every corridor. Bring what counters them.

market.infoIntro: The Elemental Points Market works like a real-time stock exchange:
market.infoBuySell: Buy and sell in lots of 100 to 100,000 points
market.infoBuyImpact: Each purchase increases the price by 2.5%+ (scales with sequence)
market.infoSellImpact: Each sale reduces the price by 2.5%+ (consecutive sales drain the price)
market.infoReset: Every 2 hours prices are adjusted with a new baseline
market.infoOracle: Oracle gives hints about price direction (60% accuracy)
market.infoProfitTip: Buy during CRASH or sell during SURGE for extra profit!
market.infoPlatinum: Platinum is bought with money at an increasing price. Buy on sale!
market.infoFee: 1% fee on each buy and sell (money destroyed)
market.infoCandles: Green candles = price went up; red candles = went down
